```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(dplyr); library(purrr); library(ggplot2)
source("model_functions.R")
```

# Model parameters and analysis settings

Exposure and scenario inputs are evaluated in the variability layer; paired Emax–EC50 draws represent pharmacodynamic uncertainty.

```{r model-parameters}
alpha <- 0.60; beta <- 1.31e6; tfs <- 1; MIC <- 0.13
C_min <- 75; C_max <- 1100; M_shape <- 0.8760928; M_scale <- 43.276368
F_min <- 0.0018; F_max <- 0.0233; fr_min <- 0; fr_max <- 0.5
pMIC_min <- 0; pMIC_max <- 10
n_outer <- 500; n <- 15; Nu <- 100; Nc <- 100
seed <- 123; pawn_seed <- 0; ncores <- 4
critval <- 1.36 * sqrt((Nu + Nc) / (Nu * Nc))
stopifnot(Nu == Nc, Nu <= n_outer)

exposure <- read.csv("raw_shrimp_mc2d_simulation_data.csv") |> arrange(inner_id)
exposure_names <- c("B_retail", "M", "F_pathogenic")
stopifnot(all(exposure_names %in% names(exposure)))
variability_inner <- exposure[, exposure_names]; n_inner <- nrow(variability_inner)
```

# Pharmacodynamic uncertainty

Conditioning on either pharmacodynamic parameter preserves its covariance with the other.

```{r pd-uncertainty}
pd_estimates <- c(Emax_per_day = 81.587790, EC50_ug_mL = 0.166877)
pd_covariance <- matrix(c(32.631766, 0.124149033, 0.124149033, 0.002101326), 2, 2,
                        byrow = TRUE, dimnames = list(names(pd_estimates), names(pd_estimates)))

rposnorm <- function(N, mean, sd) {
  x <- rnorm(N, mean, sd)
  while (any(x <= 0)) x[x <= 0] <- rnorm(sum(x <= 0), mean, sd)
  x
}

draw_pd <- function(N) {
  x <- MASS::mvrnorm(N, pd_estimates, pd_covariance)
  invalid <- x[, 1] <= 0 | x[, 2] <= 0
  while (any(invalid)) {
    x[invalid, ] <- MASS::mvrnorm(sum(invalid), pd_estimates, pd_covariance)
    invalid <- x[, 1] <= 0 | x[, 2] <= 0
  }
  data.frame(Emax_per_day = x[, 1], EC50_ug_mL = x[, 2])
}

draw_conditional_pd <- function(N, condition_on, value) {
  mu1 <- pd_estimates[1]; mu2 <- pd_estimates[2]
  v1 <- pd_covariance[1, 1]; v2 <- pd_covariance[2, 2]; cv <- pd_covariance[1, 2]

  if (condition_on == "Emax_per_day") {
    Emax <- rep(value, N)
    EC50 <- rposnorm(N, mu2 + cv / v1 * (value - mu1), sqrt(v2 - cv^2 / v1))
  } else if (condition_on == "EC50_ug_mL") {
    EC50 <- rep(value, N)
    Emax <- rposnorm(N, mu1 + cv / v2 * (value - mu2), sqrt(v1 - cv^2 / v2))
  } else stop("Unknown pharmacodynamic conditioning variable.")

  data.frame(Emax_per_day = Emax, EC50_ug_mL = EC50)
}

set.seed(seed); pd_outer <- draw_pd(n_outer)
```

# PAWN design functions

PAWN uses 15 conditioning quantiles and two-sample Kolmogorov–Smirnov distances.

```{r pawn-functions}
pawn_probs <- (seq_len(n) - 0.5) / n

make_design <- function(sample_inputs, input_names, condition_values, seed) {
  set.seed(seed); P <- length(input_names)
  unconditional <- sample_inputs(Nu); conditional <- sample_inputs(P * n * Nc)
  for (j in seq_len(P)) for (k in seq_len(n)) {
    idx <- ((j - 1) * n * Nc + (k - 1) * Nc + 1):((j - 1) * n * Nc + k * Nc)
    conditional[idx, input_names[j]] <- condition_values[[input_names[j]]][k]
  }
  list(unconditional = unconditional, conditional = conditional,
       input_names = input_names, condition_values = condition_values)
}

make_pd_design <- function(unconditional_pd, seed) {
  set.seed(seed); input_names <- c("Emax_per_day", "EC50_ug_mL")
  unconditional <- unconditional_pd[seq_len(Nu), , drop = FALSE]
  condition_values <- lapply(draw_pd(50000)[, input_names, drop = FALSE],
                             quantile, probs = pawn_probs, names = FALSE)
  conditional <- map_dfr(input_names, function(input) {
    map_dfr(condition_values[[input]], ~draw_conditional_pd(Nc, input, .x))
  })
  list(unconditional = unconditional, conditional = conditional,
       input_names = input_names, condition_values = condition_values)
}

calculate_ks <- function(y_u, y_c, input_names) {
  KS <- matrix(NA_real_, length(input_names), n,
               dimnames = list(input_names, paste0("Condition_", seq_len(n))))
  for (j in seq_along(input_names)) for (k in seq_len(n)) {
    idx <- ((j - 1) * n * Nc + (k - 1) * Nc + 1):((j - 1) * n * Nc + k * Nc)
    KS[j, k] <- unname(suppressWarnings(ks.test(y_u, y_c[idx], exact = FALSE)$statistic))
  }
  KS
}

parallel_lapply <- function(N, FUN) {
  if (ncores > 1 && .Platform$OS.type != "windows")
    parallel::mclapply(seq_len(N), FUN, mc.cores = ncores, mc.set.seed = FALSE)
  else lapply(seq_len(N), FUN)
}
```

# Input designs

The same PAWN input design is reused across 500 pharmacodynamic draws.

```{r input-designs}
sample_inner <- function(N) data.frame(
  B_retail = runif(N, C_min, C_max),
  M = rgamma(N, M_shape, scale = M_scale),
  F_pathogenic = runif(N, F_min, F_max),
  fr = runif(N, fr_min, fr_max),
  pMIC = runif(N, pMIC_min, pMIC_max)
)

inner_conditions <- list(
  B_retail = qunif(pawn_probs, C_min, C_max),
  M = qgamma(pawn_probs, M_shape, scale = M_scale),
  F_pathogenic = qunif(pawn_probs, F_min, F_max),
  fr = qunif(pawn_probs, fr_min, fr_max),
  pMIC = qunif(pawn_probs, pMIC_min, pMIC_max)
)

inner_names <- names(inner_conditions)
inner_design <- make_design(sample_inner, inner_names, inner_conditions, pawn_seed)
pd_design <- make_pd_design(pd_outer, pawn_seed + 1)

set.seed(pawn_seed + 2)
inner_reference <- transform(variability_inner,
                             fr = runif(n_inner, fr_min, fr_max),
                             pMIC = runif(n_inner, pMIC_min, pMIC_max))
```

# SD-DRM evaluation

Model probabilities are computed on their original scale.

```{r sensitivity-model}
pd_lookup_values <- bind_rows(pd_outer, pd_design$unconditional, pd_design$conditional)
ab_lookup <- make_ab_lookup(alpha = alpha, beta = beta,
                            Emax = pd_lookup_values$Emax_per_day,
                            EC50 = pd_lookup_values$EC50_ug_mL,
                            C_max = pMIC_max / 100 * MIC, tfs = tfs,
                            n_grid = 250, seed = pawn_seed, nsim = 1000)

event_risk <- function(x, Emax, EC50) {
  N <- nrow(x)
  calc_sd_drm(
    dose = x$B_retail * x$M * x$F_pathogenic, fr = x$fr,
    C = x$pMIC / 100 * MIC, alpha = alpha, beta = beta,
    Emax = rep(Emax, length.out = N), EC50 = rep(EC50, length.out = N),
    tfs = tfs, ab_lookup = ab_lookup
  )$risk_total
}
```

# Inner-layer sensitivity with propagated uncertainty

For each condition, KS distances are summarised across the 500 paired pharmacodynamic draws.

```{r inner-pawn}
run_inner_outer <- function(u) {
  Emax <- pd_outer$Emax_per_day[u]; EC50 <- pd_outer$EC50_ug_mL[u]
  calculate_ks(event_risk(inner_design$unconditional, Emax, EC50),
               event_risk(inner_design$conditional, Emax, EC50), inner_names)
}

inner_ks <- simplify2array(parallel_lapply(n_outer, run_inner_outer))
dimnames(inner_ks) <- list(inner_names, paste0("Condition_", seq_len(n)),
                           paste0("Outer_", seq_len(n_outer)))
inner_condition_median <- apply(inner_ks, c(1, 2), median, na.rm = TRUE)
inner_condition_lower <- apply(inner_ks, c(1, 2), quantile, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)
inner_condition_upper <- apply(inner_ks, c(1, 2), quantile, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
```

# Pharmacodynamic uncertainty sensitivity

Sensitivity to Emax and EC50 is evaluated on mean illness risk across a common exposure reference sample.

```{r uncertainty-pawn}
evaluate_pd <- function(data) unlist(parallel_lapply(nrow(data), function(i) {
  mean(event_risk(inner_reference, data$Emax_per_day[i], data$EC50_ug_mL[i]))
}), use.names = FALSE)

pd_ks <- calculate_ks(evaluate_pd(pd_design$unconditional),
                      evaluate_pd(pd_design$conditional), pd_design$input_names)
```

# Sensitivity summaries

PAWN indices are medians of the 15 condition-specific KS distances.

```{r pawn-summary}
parameter_labels <- c(B_retail = "B_retail", M = "M", F_pathogenic = "F_pathogenic",
                      fr = "f_r", pMIC = "pMIC", Emax_per_day = "Emax", EC50_ug_mL = "EC50")
component_map <- c(B_retail = "Exposure variability", M = "Exposure variability",
                   F_pathogenic = "Exposure variability", fr = "Scenario inputs",
                   pMIC = "Scenario inputs", Emax_per_day = "Pharmacodynamic uncertainty",
                   EC50_ug_mL = "Pharmacodynamic uncertainty")

summarise_ks <- function(x) {
  q <- t(apply(x, 1, quantile, c(0.025, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE))
  data.frame(
    Component = unname(component_map[rownames(x)]),
    Parameter = unname(parameter_labels[rownames(x)]),
    Mean_KS = rowMeans(x, na.rm = TRUE), P2.5_KS = q[, 1], P25_KS = q[, 2],
    Median_PAWN = q[, 3], P75_KS = q[, 4], P97.5_KS = q[, 5],
    Minimum_KS = apply(x, 1, min, na.rm = TRUE), Maximum_KS = apply(x, 1, max, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

condition_matrix <- rbind(inner_condition_median, pd_ks)
pawn_summary <- summarise_ks(condition_matrix) |>
  group_by(Component) |>
  mutate(Rank = rank(-Median_PAWN, ties.method = "min")) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(Component, Parameter, Rank, everything())

make_condition_table <- function(parameter, matrix, lower = NULL, upper = NULL,
                                 values, basis) data.frame(
  Component = unname(component_map[parameter]), Parameter = unname(parameter_labels[parameter]),
  Condition = seq_len(n), Conditioning_quantile = pawn_probs,
  Conditioning_value = values[[parameter]], Median_KS = matrix[parameter, ],
  P2.5_outer_KS = if (is.null(lower)) NA_real_ else lower[parameter, ],
  P97.5_outer_KS = if (is.null(upper)) NA_real_ else upper[parameter, ], Basis = basis
)

condition_summary <- bind_rows(
  map_dfr(inner_names, make_condition_table, matrix = inner_condition_median,
          lower = inner_condition_lower, upper = inner_condition_upper,
          values = inner_design$condition_values,
          basis = "Median and 95% range across paired PD outer draws"),
  map_dfr(pd_design$input_names, make_condition_table, matrix = pd_ks,
          values = pd_design$condition_values,
          basis = "KS distance after averaging over the inner reference sample")
)

dir.create("results", showWarnings = FALSE)
write.csv(pawn_summary, file.path("results", "pawn_2d_illness_risk_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(condition_summary, file.path("results", "pawn_condition_specific_ks.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
knitr::kable(pawn_summary, digits = 3,
             caption = "Two-dimensional PAWN sensitivity summary for illness risk")
```

# Sensitivity figure

Each point is a condition-specific KS distance; box medians indicate PAWN indices.

```{r pawn-figure, include=FALSE}
component_levels <- c("Exposure variability", "Scenario inputs", "Pharmacodynamic uncertainty")
parameter_levels <- pawn_summary |>
  mutate(Component = factor(Component, component_levels)) |>
  arrange(Component, Rank) |> pull(Parameter)

plot_data <- as.data.frame(as.table(condition_matrix), responseName = "KS") |>
  transmute(Component = unname(component_map[as.character(Var1)]),
            Parameter = unname(parameter_labels[as.character(Var1)]), KS) |>
  mutate(Component = factor(Component, component_levels),
         Parameter = factor(Parameter, parameter_levels))

pawn_plot <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(Parameter, KS)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.55, coef = Inf, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "grey80") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.10, height = 0, alpha = 0.45, size = 1.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = critval, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.45) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
    B_retail = expression(B[retail]), M = expression(M),
    F_pathogenic = expression(F[pathogenic]), f_r = expression(f[r]),
    pMIC = expression(pMIC), Emax = expression(E[max]), EC50 = expression(EC[50])
  )) +
  facet_grid(. ~ Component, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "PAWN index",
       caption = "The dashed line indicates the Kolmogorov–Smirnov (KS) threshold used in the PAWN analysis.") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14), axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
        plot.caption = element_text(size = 10.5, hjust = 1), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

figure_file <- file.path("images", "pawn_2d_illness_risk.png")
dir.create(dirname(figure_file), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave(figure_file, pawn_plot, width = 12, height = 5.5, dpi = 600, bg = "white")
```

```{r display-pawn-figure, echo=FALSE, out.width="100%"}
knitr::include_graphics(figure_file)
```

```{r analysis-settings}
settings <- data.frame(
  Setting = c("Inner reference observations", "Outer PD simulations", "Conditioning values",
              "PAWN unconditional outputs", "Conditional outputs per condition", "KS reference value",
              "Exposure-variability inputs", "Scenario-range inputs",
              "Outer uncertainty inputs", "Emax-EC50 dependence", "Sensitivity output"),
  Value = c(n_inner, n_outer, n, Nu, Nc, round(critval, 4),
            "B_retail, M, and F_pathogenic", "f_r and pMIC",
            "Emax and EC50", "Preserved by paired and conditional sampling", "Illness risk")
)
```
